chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever increases his salat (prayer) during the night, his face becomes beautiful during the day."

key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, the Divine Name of God
key_terms.رَسُولُ: Messenger; referring here to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.صَلَاتُهُ: his salat (prayer), meaning his devotional prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of increasing night prayer in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of abundant night salat (prayer) and its visible effect upon a person. It indicates that worship in the night brings beauty and radiance to one’s appearance by day.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1370 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"Whoever increases their prayers during the night will have a radiant face during the day."
